plugins.Author: Kage
plugins.Name: QuickTransfer
plugins.Description: Automate inventory transfers with Shift/Ctrl/Alt + Right-Click. Trade window, vendor quick sell, FC chest.
plugins.Changelog:
**Fixes**
- **Shortcuts are less likely to stop working after a game patch.** QuickTransfer now has a backup way to connect to the game's item menu if the usual one isn't available.
- **More quantity prompts get filled in automatically.** Some "How many?" prompts were sometimes skipped instead of being filled and confirmed.
- **Corrected the Debug mode description.** Settings now says debug logs go to `/xllog`, not to chat.

**Improvements**
- Behind-the-scenes cleanup for better stability and performance, especially when organizing the FC chest.
- QuickTransfer now frees all of its memory when you disable or update it.
